Pin captions to one safe zone (the bottom strip used from seg1 onward) for the entire video, including the hook.

problems: hook@0.3-2.2: opens on a near-empty chart slowly filling behind a title-card caption - the exact slow-chart-build the rubric forbids, and Data's body hides the '1972' row label.
seg0/seg1 are the same bar-race template twice in a row with only the dataset swapped; nothing about the visual tells the two indicators apart.

seg0:start-seg0:end: the sub-head reads '1972 PULLS AHEAD' while the 1972 bar is visibly the shortest, and the bars rise across the beat - directly contradicting the title/hook claim that land shrank.
hook through seg1:end: Data stands in one arms-out pose sliding across the frame, occluding bar ends and year labels (hook@0.3 hides '1972', seg0:end hides the row label behind 'to 129,763,686').
seg1:start-seg1:mid: bars animate with no values on them, so ~10s of growth is unreadable; numbers only appear at seg1:end.
seg4:start-payoff@-0.4: the closing quote box is stacked directly on top of the 'Crop production index' title, producing a garbled double-printed headline (seg4:mid, seg4:end).
fixes: Replace the hook with a pre-loaded chart and an immediate physical event in frame 1 (Data yanking the 2023 bar backwards as the land figure ticks down) instead of bars filling from zero behind a title.
Author a distinct per-beat performance for seg0, seg1 and seg2 so no two beats reuse the arms-out standing pose - each bit must have setup, action and payoff attached to that beat's specific number.
Fix the sub-head generator: either label the actually-leading row or drop the 'X PULLS AHEAD' line - '1972 PULLS AHEAD' is false against the rendered bars.
Reconcile the script with the data or re-cut the visual: the hook promises a shrink and seg0 renders a 25-year climb; show the 2013->2023 downtick explicitly as the demonstrated moment.

Reveal each bar's value as the bar lands rather than only at the end of the beat, and keep Data's bounding box out of the bar-end and year-label zones (offset him to the right gutter or scale him down).
Move the closing quote card to a clean lower-third or fade the section title before it appears, so seg4 never double-prints the headline.

one_line: Real sourced data and a genuinely animated race, but it opens on a slow chart build with the mascot and captions sitting on top of the bars, and the closing card collides with the chart title.
problems: hook@0.3–2.2: slow bar build from zero, no event in the first two seconds; mascot's body covers the 1972 row label and the caption sits across the bar he stands on.
seg0:start–seg1:mid: the mascot is parked center-frame over the 1972/1982 bars with no bit tied to land area, and he occludes the bar tips and value labels that are the whole point of the race.

seg1:end: values 104217084 vs 104215245 vs 125847588 render as near-identical bar lengths, so the 'leapt' and 'slipped' beats read visually the same — the shrink the title promises is never shown as a shrink.

seg4:start–seg4:end and payoff@-0.4: the closing callout box overprints the 'Crop production index' title into an unreadable glyph pile-up, and payoff@-1.8 stacks callout + caption + 'COMMENT BELOW' + source line in the lower frame at once.
seg3:start: the top third of the frame is blank navy above the chart while the mascot and the action sit low-left.
fixes: Start the hook with bars already extended and diverging (or cut in on the 2013→2023 drop) so motion and a reason to stay exist at frame 1.

Constrain the mascot to the right gutter during the bar-race scenes (seg0–seg2) so row labels and bar tips are never covered, and give him a land-specific bit — e.g. shoving a bar backwards as the 2023 value slips.
Rescale the land-area bars against a non-zero baseline (or show delta bars) so 104M vs 129M vs the 2023 dip are visibly different lengths.

Hold the closing callout until the chart title has cleared the frame, or drop the title on the closing beat — never render both in the same band; and suppress the narration caption while 'COMMENT BELOW' is on screen.
Raise the crop-index chart into the empty upper third of seg3 so the frame's space is used.

one_line: Clean, honest bar-race data work undone by a mascot who never performs and a closing beat where the callout text overprints the chart title.
auto_fails: decorative_mascot: Data hovers in the same mid-right spot with identical arm-out pose across seg0:start, seg1:mid, seg2:end and seg3:mid — he never sets up or pays off any bit tied to a stat; at seg3:start he holds a flat teal slab near 20.8 that reads as a prop with no action.
empty_void: seg3:start/seg3:mid leave the entire top half (y≈150–380) blank navy above the flat 20.8 line, and the bar-race frames (seg2:start) leave wide empty gutters right of every unfilled track.
problems: seg4: closing callout overlaps and obliterates the 'Crop production index' title; axis labels clipped to 'C'/'19' and the '100' endpoint runs off the right edge.
Data is decorative for the entire runtime — same hovering arm-out pose at seg0:start, seg1:mid, seg2:end, seg3:mid; no setup→action→payoff tied to any number.
Hook (hook@0.3–2.2) is a slow bar-race build with the caption text sitting on top of the mascot and the 1972 bar; nothing surprising happens in the first 2s.
seg3:start/seg3:mid waste the top half of the frame on empty navy while the line sits flat at 20.8 in the lower third.
seg0/seg1 bar tracks show large unfilled grey gutters (seg2:start) — the frame's width is not used.
The subtitle burn-in collides with chart elements repeatedly (hook@1.5 'Earth's total' covers the 1972 bar; seg1:end caption sits over the source line).
fixes: Move the closing callout below the header band or cross-fade the scene title out before it renders, and clamp the endpoint value label inside a right safe margin.
Give Data one concrete bit per segment tied to the stat: shove the 1972 bar forward in seg0, get flattened by the 2018 dip in seg2, ride the 1991→2001 cliff up in seg3.
Open on the surprise: start the hook mid-race with the 2023 bar snapping backwards, or a land-mass chunk falling away, before any title settles.
Scale the seg3 area chart to fill the frame vertically so the flat 20.8 stretch is not floating under a half-frame of empty navy.
Trim the bar tracks to the max value plus a small pad so the race fills the frame width instead of leaving grey gutters.
Reserve a caption safe-zone that excludes the chart body so subtitles stop landing on top of bars, the mascot, and the source credit.

one_line: Three unrelated World Bank charts stapled under a renewables title, opened on a slow irrigation bar build while the hook talks about green energy.
auto_fails: decorative_mascot: Data holds the same walking/reaching pose and merely slides along the bar tip or line — identical silhouette at hook@0.3, seg0:mid, seg1:end, seg2:start, seg2:end, seg3:mid and payoff@-0.4 — never a setup->action->payoff tied to a number.
problems: hook@0.3–hook@2.2: plain title card plus near-empty bars; the promised renewables subject is absent for the first ~30s.

seg0/seg1 (irrigation) and seg2 (broadband) have nothing to do with the title 'World Renewable Power Was Still Only 19.7%' — the payoff line at payoff@-0.4 lands on a claim two-thirds of the video never argued.
seg1:end: value labels are occluded by their own bars — Suriname reads '4.4', Pakistan '4.2', India '4.4', Bahrain '0.9' instead of 74.4 / 54.2 / 44.4 / 40.9.
seg4:start–payoff@-0.4: the closing caption box sits on top of the chart title, cutting 'Renewable electricity output' in half and hiding the '1990 → 2021' subtitle.
payoff@-1.8 and seg4:end: the '27.8' end-value label is clipped by the right frame edge.
Mascot is the same pose in every scene, riding the bar tip or the line — decoration that tracks a value rather than a performer with a bit.
fixes: Reorder so the renewables line chart is scene 1 and opens mid-motion on the 1990→2009 flatline; demote or cut the irrigation and broadband beats, or rewrite the hook/title to the 'three numbers that barely moved' framing the closing actually pays off.
Give Data one distinct act per scene: straining to drag the flat 1990–2009 line upward and failing, then getting carried by the 2015–2021 climb — setup, action, payoff.
Move bar value labels outside the bar (or to the track) once fill width exceeds the label width, so 74.4 / 54.2 / 44.4 / 40.9 read fully at seg1:end.
Anchor the closing caption box to the lower third instead of over the header, and inset the end-value label so '27.8' clears the right safe margin.
Fill seg3's upper band: raise the plot area or park the title/stat callout there so the frame is used top to bottom.

one_line: Real chart demonstrations and a mascot who actually performs, wrecked by a closing card that sits on top of the headline and a title-card hook that gives a scroller nothing in the first two seconds.
problems: hook@0.3–hook@2.2: the opening is a plain title card ('Agricultural irrigated land / BANGLADESH TOPS THE LIST') with five pinhead dots slowly inflating — a slow chart build, exactly the opening the rubric forbids; nothing happens for the first ~2s.
seg4:start–payoff@-0.4: closing callout overlays and truncates the chart headline ('...ut', then 'R'), its text spills past its own border, and it duplicates the source credit line at the bottom.
seg2 (seg2:start–seg2:end): the kicker reads '2005 PULLS AHEAD' while the bars plainly show 2005 as the SHORTEST (3.4) and 2021 the longest (16.7) — the label contradicts the picture.
seg1:end (16.95s): caption says 'and Bahrain' while the emphasized green number is '54.2' (Pakistan), not Bahrain's 40.9 — the highlighted number is out of sync with the spoken words.
seg2:start: bar values are hidden behind the mascot/empty until seg2:end, so for most of the beat the bars are unlabelled shapes.
The title promises renewable power at 19.7%, but the first 17s (hook through seg1:end) are about irrigated farmland — the payoff stat arrives more than halfway in.
fixes: Move the closing callout into the empty band between the axis labels and the source line, auto-shrink its text to fit inside the border, and never let it cover the chart headline; render the source strip once.
Animate the final 6s: have Data haul the 2021 endpoint up to 27.8 while a ghost marker holds at 19.3/19.7 so the 'two decades, barely moved' point is SHOWN, not just narrated.
Open on motion that belongs to the headline stat — e.g. the renewable line flatlining across the frame for two decades then the mascot stomping on it — instead of a title card with dots inflating.
Derive the bar-race kicker from the current leader ('2021 PULLS AHEAD') or drop it; never label the shortest bar as ahead.
Bind the highlighted number to the word being spoken so 'Bahrain' lights 40.9, not 54.2.
Show each bar's value on the bar from the moment it grows, and keep the mascot off the value labels.

one_line: Solid animated chart work in the middle, but the first two seconds are an empty title card whose words promise green energy while the screen shows irrigated farmland.
auto_fails: empty_void: hook@0.3 and hook@0.8 are ~70% empty navy with five 6px dots and a thumbnail-size mascot; seg3:start–seg3:end leave a tall dead band between the subtitle and the 27.8 gridline.
problems: hook@0.3/hook@0.8: title-card opening over an empty field of five sub-pixel dots — no motion worth staying for, and the mascot is thumbnail-sized.
hook: narration says 'green energy took off' while the on-screen chart and title are 'Agricultural irrigated land' — the hook sells a stat that arrives 33s later.
seg2:start/seg2:mid: subtitle reads '2005 PULLS AHEAD' on a chart where 2005 is the smallest bar (3.4) and 2021 the largest (16.7) — the kicker states the opposite of the data.
seg4:start–payoff@-0.4: the orange closing callout box sits on top of the scene title for the last ~7s, clipping 'Renewable electricity output' and the '1990 → 2021' subtitle.
seg1:start/seg1:end: burned-in captions ('farmland, Suriname 74.4,' / '44.4, and Bahrain') fall outside the card and across the red divider into the letterbox strip.
seg4:start onward: two stacked source footers — the per-scene credit plus a three-source line in the bottom letterbox at 6px, unreadable and cluttering the payoff.
fixes: Rebuild the hook as live motion: enter on the bubbles already inflating (or the renewable curve flat-lining) at full frame scale, kill the static title card, and up the mascot to at least 2x so he reads at 0.3s.
Re-cut the hook line to name the stat that is actually on screen at t=0 (irrigation), or reorder so the renewable-power scene opens the video and matches 'green energy'.
Fix the seg2 subtitle to describe the real trend ('2005 STARTS AT 3.4' or '2021 PULLS AHEAD') — it currently contradicts its own bars.
Move the closing callout to the lower third or fade the scene title before it lands so nothing overlaps in seg4/payoff.
Clamp caption baselines inside the card's safe area so seg1 lines stop bleeding over the divider.
Drop the duplicated aggregate source strip in the letterbox — keep the single per-scene credit.

one_line: Competent chart work with one genuinely good mascot bit at the end, but it opens on a plain title card over empty bars and spends its first 25 seconds on a dataset the title never mentions.
problems: hook@0.3–hook@0.8: plain title card, all five bars empty, no demonstration for the first ~2.3s — the rubric's explicit anti-pattern.
Hook line says 'China built the world's biggest railroad' while hook@0.3 through seg1:end show mobile subscriptions; the rail stat that titles the video doesn't appear until seg2:start (t=26s).
Craft, seg0:start–seg1:mid: the mascot sits on top of the rank labels, truncating '1. China' to '1. Chi...' in hook@0.8 and seg0:start.
Craft, seg1:mid and seg2:start: three text layers stack at once — subtitle line, giant green numeral, and the source strip — plus a stray cyan ellipse floating over the bars with no referent.

payoff@-1.8 to payoff@-0.4: the closing card 'Infrastructure headlines don't always match the numbers' sits over the METHANE chart, covering its title; the rail reveal it refers to is 20 seconds behind.
seg0–seg2: the mascot's only action is riding the tip of the growing bar — motion without a bit; the real performance doesn't start until seg3.
fixes: Re-cut the segment order so the rail comparison (seg2) is first, directly under the rail hook line, and open with the bars already racing rather than empty.
Give the first 2 seconds a physical beat: mascot shoving/stretching the US rail bar past China's, landing on the 148,553 vs 109,767 gap as the opening image.
Offset the mascot's anchor so he never overlaps the rank labels — park him right of the bar tip or above the plot, not on the label column.
Drop either the giant green numeral or the subtitle line during seg1:mid/seg2:start; one number treatment per beat.
Remove the unexplained cyan ellipse in seg1:mid and seg2:start, or bind it to the value it is meant to circle.
Move the closing card so it lands over the rail chart (or re-show the rail bars behind it) and stop it covering the chart title.

one_line: Three unrelated stats stapled together, ending on a methane chart while the closing line and CTA talk about railroads — and the mascot keeps standing in front of the labels he is supposed to be pointing at.
problems: The hook narration says 'China built the world's biggest railroad — it hasn't' while hook@0.3 through hook@2.2 show a mobile-subscriptions bar chart; the promised topic and the visible topic disagree for the entire opening.

Persistent occlusion: caption text lands on Data's face at hook@0.3 ('You've probably'), and Data's body covers the '1. United States o…' label at seg2:start and eats the leading digit of '148553' at seg2:end and '1151356612' at seg1:end.
seg4's closing bubble covers the chart title — seg4:mid shows only 'Me…' and '197…' of 'Methane (CH4) emissions from Agriculture / 1972 → 2024'.
Editorial incoherence: seg3's methane stat belongs to neither the title nor the closing question, and the CTA at payoff@-1.8 offers only 'phones or the railroads' while methane fills the frame.
seg3:start wastes the top third of the frame as blank navy above the 4334 gridline while the chart is squeezed into the lower half.
At seg1:start the caption 'mobile subscriptions, more' overlaps the source credit line at the panel's bottom edge.
fixes: Reorder so the rail comparison opens the video: put the US vs China rail bars under the hook line so 'it hasn't' is proved by the visible bar at ~1s, and demote mobile subscriptions to a later beat.
Add a mascot/label collision constraint — offset Data's x-position (or the bar's value label) whenever his bounding box overlaps a bar label or value, so seg1:end and seg2:end read at a glance.
Anchor the closing bubble to the empty upper band instead of the panel top edge so the chart title stays legible through seg4.
Rebuild seg4 as a dedicated payoff frame on the rail data that the CTA names, with Data planting a flag at the end of the longer US bar rather than idling on a leftover methane curve.
Either cut the methane segment or rewrite the closing question to cover all three stats, so the CTA is not asking about content the last 15 seconds never showed.
Raise the seg3 chart plot area to fill the blank upper third, or move the '1972 → 2024' range label and a callout into that space.

one_line: Two off-topic bar races (65+ share, rural population) eat the first 65 of 96 seconds before the titular urban-growth stat ever appears, and Data never performs — he stands and slides.
auto_fails: decorative_mascot: seg3:start/mid/end (t=74.8/79.9/84.9s) show Data in the identical standing pose, arms down, only translated left-to-right across the line chart — no setup, no action, no payoff tied to the 1.36% fall; same passive stand in seg1:mid and seg2:mid.
problems: hook@0.3–2.2: the hook line says 'cities are exploding faster than ever' over a chart titled 'Population ages 65 and above' — the opening visual contradicts the promise, and it is a slow bar build rather than an immediate event
seg1:end (26.74s) and seg2:end (64.48s) are the same bar-race treatment twice in a row; nothing distinguishes the two data stories visually
seg2:end: bar labels print raw unformatted digits ('2420179648', '2783042387') while the caption reads the properly grouped '3,464,845,933' — sloppy and unreadable at scroll speed

seg4:start–payoff@-0.4: the closing speech bubble covers the chart title ('Urban population growth' is chopped at every frame from 89.62s on), and a ghost duplicate '2.8' label floats outside the axis at 92.22s
payoff@-1.8/-0.4: source line, closing caption and 'COMMENT BELOW' stack and overlap at the bottom of the frame
seg3:start: top third of the frame is empty above the axis while the mascot stands idle mid-chart
fixes: Open on the urban-growth curve collapsing (or Data physically failing to hold the line up) so frame 1 matches the hook's claim; move the 65+ and rural charts after the headline stat, or cut one of them
Author a distinct per-beat performance for Data in every segment — riding the falling line in seg3, being buried by the growing rural bars in seg2 — instead of the shared idle stand pose
Format bar value labels with thousands separators (or abbreviate to '2.42B') so they match the narration
Reposition the closing bubble below the title or fade the title out before it appears; remove the duplicated off-axis '2.8' label
De-conflict the bottom stack: one caption lane, sources at reduced opacity behind, CTA on its own beat
Cut total runtime toward 45–60s by dropping one bar-race segment and tightening the year-by-year recitations

one_line: Real World Bank data and clean motion, but Data is wallpaper for the whole 96 seconds and two of the three beats aren't even about the urban-growth headline.
auto_fails: decorative_mascot: Data holds the identical arms-out hover pose beside the leading bar at seg0:mid (t=4.82s), seg1:start (14.05s), seg1:end (26.74s) and seg2:mid (52.28s), then simply stands still on the plot at seg3:mid (79.86s) and seg4:end (94.82s) — no setup, action or payoff tied to any stat.
problems: Hook (0.3–2.2s) is the exact thing the rubric forbids: a slow bar-chart build behind caption text, with no event in the first second.
Decorative mascot throughout — identical hover pose at seg0:mid, seg1:start/end and seg2:mid, then a static standing pose at seg3:mid and seg4:end.
Topic mismatch: the title promises urban growth at a 50-year low, but seg0/seg1 chart 65+ population and seg2 charts rural population; the payoff stat only appears at seg3:end (84.92s).
seg2:end (64.48s) prints raw 10-digit values ('2420179648') inside the bars — unreadable and unformatted.
Subtitle '1972 PULLS AHEAD' is wrong on every bar-race frame; 2014 is plainly the longest bar at seg1:end and seg2:end.
At seg3:start (74.80s) and seg3:mid (79.86s) the mascot stands directly on the trend line, occluding the very decline the video is about.
fixes: Open on a physical event in frame 1 — the 2025 urban-growth line snapping downward or a city block deflating — before any chart axis draws.
Author a distinct bit per beat: Data climbing the rising 65+ bars at seg0/seg1, bracing the rural bar at seg2, and riding the line down and landing hard at 1.36 in seg3.
Reorder so the urban-growth line chart (seg3) leads and the 65+/rural charts support it, matching the title's promise.
Format large values as 2.42B / 3.46B and keep labels clear of the mascot's bounding box.
Replace the '1972 PULLS AHEAD' subtitle with the beat's actual movement, or drop it when the leader is not the first row.
Offset the mascot to the right gutter during the line-chart beats so the trend line is never occluded, and shrink/reposition the closing bubble below the title with a single source-credit line.

one_line: Competent, smoothly animated bar race, but the headline numbers appear as raw 8-digit integers that contradict the 'million metric tons' voiceover, and the mascot plus captions sit on top of the very bars the beat is about.
problems: seg0/seg1: bar labels show unformatted raw values (51915952 … 93466633) while the caption and VO say 'million metric tons' — the number on screen is wrong by a factor of 10^6.
hook: opens as a slow bar build with a karaoke word over the mascot's face; nothing distinct happens in the first ~1s to earn the stop-scroll.
seg0 and seg1 are the same visual device (5-bar horizontal race, '19xx PULLS AHEAD' subhead) back to back, so the second stat lands as a repeat of the first.
Mascot occludes data: at hook@0.8, seg0:mid, seg1:mid and seg1:end he is standing across the 1972/1982 bars and their labels.
seg4: the yellow speech bubble covers the chart title and the '20' y-axis label (seg4:start, seg4:mid, payoff@-0.4) — the closing frame reads as two layers fighting.
seg1: 2023 (13.7) renders shorter than 2020 (14.2) while the caption claims growth 'to 17.5 percent' — the final on-screen bar never shows the 17.5 the line asserts.
fixes: Scale/format all capture-fisheries bar labels to millions with one decimal ('88.8M', '94.4M') so on-screen numbers match the narration; apply the same formatter to the title text.
Give the mascot a lane clear of the bar labels (right gutter or below the last bar) for seg0/seg1, or fade bars' value chips in only once he has moved off them.
Replace seg1's bar race with a different device — an ocean-area fill/tile grid going from 6.8% to 17.5% shaded — so consecutive beats do not reuse the same chart form.
Open on the mascot physically hitting a ceiling (bar slams into a wall and stops) in the first 0.5s instead of a bar build, then run the race under it.
Move the closing speech bubble below the title or shrink it so the chart title, the 17 endpoint and the bubble each own their own space.
Show the 17.5% endpoint on the marine chart (extend to the 2025 value the caption cites) so the spoken number and the last bar agree.

one_line: Real data, honest sourcing and constant motion, but it is three stock chart animations with the mascot parked on top of the numbers he is blocking - nothing is demonstrated, only plotted.
auto_fails: decorative_mascot: For the first ~23s (hook@0.8, seg0:mid, seg1:start, seg2:start/mid) Data just stands arms-out in the middle of the bar track and slides sideways with no setup->action->payoff tied to any stat; only at seg3:end/seg4 does he ride the line down to 9.1.
problems: Hook is a slow bar-race build under a plain title card - hook@0.3 to hook@2.2 show only bars creeping right, no event in the first two seconds.

Caption text collides with data throughout the opening: 'Two of' (hook@0.3), 'toughest health' (hook@1.5, seg0:start) and 'numbers are' (hook@2.2) are slammed over the 1972 label, the top bar and the mascot at once.
Data occludes the very numbers being narrated: seg1:start and seg1:mid have him covering the 1972/1982 bar tips; seg2:start/mid covers the 2000/2005 bars.
Value labels are low-contrast grey inside pink fills at seg1:mid and seg2:end (85, 79, 74, 61.2, 49.2 / 475.6 ... 1067) - hard to read on a phone.

The closing speech bubble crops the chart title at seg4:start and seg4:mid ('Suicide mortality rate' cut in half) and the bubble is layered over the wrong chart - the line about 'the bill' sits on the suicide-rate plot, never on the spending chart.
seg3:start leaves a wide empty band between the title block and the plot area while the mascot stands mid-plot with no bit.
fixes: Open on an event, not a build: cold-open the third stat (a bill/receipt unrolling, or the $1,317 bar smashing past the two falling ones) for the first 1.5s, then drop into seg0.
Constrain caption text to a safe band clear of the chart panel (below the source line, as it already is from seg1:end onward) so it never overlaps bars, year labels or the mascot.

Offset the mascot to a free margin per scene and give him a bit tied to the stat: in seg2 have him try to hold up the growing spending bar and get pushed back by it; in seg0/seg1 have him ride each shrinking bar down instead of standing beside it.
Move value labels outside the bar ends, or set them white with a shadow, so 475.6 -> 1,317 and 85 -> 38.3 are legible at thumb size.
Re-anchor the closing bubble: show it over the spending chart with the two falling lines shrunk into a corner, and shift the bubble so it never crops the chart title.
Demonstrate the tripling in seg2 - ghost the 2000 bar and stack three copies of it against 2018, or fill a jar three times, so the multiple is seen rather than stated.

one_line: A genuinely good race — the diesel-vs-EV crossover lands — but the opening banner collides with the diesel label and the camera crops the axis and series labels for much of the video.
problems: hook@1.5: the hook banner and the 'Diesel Cars 10.7M' tip label are stacked on each other, both illegible.
hook@0.3, hook@0.8, mid2, mid5, payoff@-1.8: y-axis tick labels are sliced by the left frame edge ('4M', '.2M', bare 'M').

mid4 (t=10.40s) and payoff@-0.4: the right-hand series labels are cut off mid-number — 'Electric Cars 9' and 'Electric Cars 14.' — so the headline value is unreadable at the exact moment EV overtakes.
hook@0.3–hook@2.2: the plot is ~70% empty black with only a 1-pixel green stub at the baseline; the opening two seconds show almost no data.
The axis title 'Global new car sales per year' is overrun by the diesel line at mid1 and clipped away entirely in several frames.
fixes: Move the hook banner above the plot area (under the leaderboard) and clear it by ~1.2s, before the first tip label enters that space.
Fix the chart viewport so the left axis labels and the right-hand series labels are inside a safe margin for the entire run — no frame should clip a number.
Start the hook on a pre-drawn partial chart (or reveal both lines fast to ~2018) so the first second shows a shape, not an empty grid.
Reserve a right-hand gutter sized to the longest series label so 'Electric Cars 14.2M' fits at the payoff.
Keep the y-axis title clear of the plotted lines, or drop it and put the unit into the leaderboard header.

one_line: A genuinely good race — real overtake, COVID crash, recovery, clean #1 payoff — sabotaged by a near-empty black opening and a camera that clips the hook text and both axis label gutters.
auto_fails: empty_void: hook@0.3 and hook@0.8 are almost entirely black — one ~1cm red stub near the top-left is the only mark in the plot area, gridlines invisible, and the whole lower two-thirds of the frame is dead space (dark_fraction 1.0); the bottom ~35% of the plot below 20M stays empty through mid1 t=4.47s.
problems: hook@0.3–0.8: the first second is an empty black chart with one tiny stub — nothing to stop a scroll, and it reads as the exact 'slow chart build' opening the rubric forbids.
hook@0.8: the hook banner 'World's Busiest Airport Flipped' is clipped at the left frame edge, losing the first character.
hook@0.3, mid2 t=6.45s, mid5 t=12.38s: the zoom pushes the y-axis tick labels off the left edge — they render as bare 'M'/'0M' fragments.
payoff@-1.8 and payoff@-0.4: the series tip labels run off the right edge ('Dubai (DXB)  8...', 'Heathrow  79...'), so the final numbers are unreadable at the exact moment they matter.

seg3/seg4 carry the stale subtitle '1972 PULLS AHEAD' over a chart where every later year is larger — the label contradicts the bars.

Re-anchor the closing bubble into the empty lower third so the chart header, the 1972 row and the full mascot stay on screen.
Regenerate the subtitle per scene from that scene's own trend (e.g. 'BACK BELOW 1972') instead of inheriting '1972 PULLS AHEAD'.

Give Data one physical bit per stat — shoving the shrinking hectares bar backwards, hauling Slovenia's fertilizer bar off the right edge — with a clear setup, action and payoff, and move him between beats.

Show each bar's value as the bar grows rather than only at the end of the scene, so the frames carry the number the VO is saying.

hook@0.3-seg0:end: the caption block sits directly on Data's face and torso ('Farmers today', "world's grain") and on the 1972 bar, reading as a collision rather than a layout.

Give seg1 a physical metaphor for 101,756% — e.g. Data stacking 1,000 fertilizer sacks against Slovenia's one — instead of a percentage on a ranked bar.

seg2 (f10,f11,f12): subtitle reads 'WOMEN IS 63% OF THE WHOLE' — broken grammar in a header that sits on screen for the whole beat.

seg4 (f16–f20): the closing card covers the chart title and the top of the 347 bar it is proving, and a second tiny duplicate source line sits under the caption bar.

Derive the subtitle from the delta for rate series — 'FROM 67% TO 87.7% IN 50 YEARS' — and make the number pop read the same value as the bar label it sits next to.
Fix the subtitle template's subject-verb agreement ('WOMEN ARE 63% OF THE TOTAL') or reword to 'WOMEN: 63% OF ILLITERATE ADULTS'.
Inset the region chart's left gutter so full row labels fit ('Central & Southern Asia', 'Sub-Saharan Africa', 'Middle East & North Africa'), or right-align the labels above their bars.
Move the closing card into the lower third or fade it in after the 347/225 bars finish extending, and delete the duplicate micro source line at the very bottom.
Open on the mascot already in motion against a single dramatic element — e.g. him hauling the 2024 bar up past the 1976 mark — rather than a chart mid-fill under a static header.

problems: hook@0.3–2.2: the video opens mid bar-build with the caption 'Everyone assumes' slapped over the mascot's face — no event, no reason to stop scrolling

seg4:start–payoff@-0.4: the closing speech bubble covers the 'Urban population growth' title and a ghost '2.8' label floats orphaned below it; duplicate source footers stack at the very bottom

fixes: Open on the collapse itself: start the urban-growth line already falling off 2.82 with Data trying to hold it up, then cut back to the setup — do not open on a slow bar build.
Differentiate the three data beats: keep one bar race, render the rural figure as a filling/stacking mass, and reserve the line chart for the punchline so no two beats share a template.
Humanize large numbers at render time ('2.42B', '3.46B') and never print raw digit strings inside bars.
Make the kicker per-metric and truthful, or drop it — 'PULLS AHEAD' must not carry over from the 65+ chart to the rural chart.

Author a per-beat mascot act tied to each stat (shoving the 1972 bar, being dragged by the growing rural mass, sliding down the falling urban line) so setup→action→payoff is visible; no reuse of the lean pose across beats.

Reflow the closing card: place the speech bubble below the title, remove the orphaned '2.8' ghost label and the duplicated source footer, and land 1.36% as an on-chart hit — number slamming onto the 2025 endpoint — rather than only in a caption.

one_line: One bar-race template repeated five times with a decorative mascot and a callout box that hides the very number the video is about — the 1.36% payoff never appears on screen.

Give Data one real bit per segment tied to the number — e.g. straining to hold the shrinking growth bar open, or riding the 2025 bar down — and change his pose and position between segments.

Differentiate seg1 from seg0: change the framing, chart state, or metaphor rather than replaying the same five rows.
Give at least one indicator a non-bar demonstration (stacking, filling, crushing) so the three stats don't read as one chart three times.
Reserve a caption safe-zone below the chart and constrain the closing card so it never overlaps the scene title; pad the right margin so value labels and the mascot are never clipped.

Offset hook captions to the lower third for the first 2.5s so the mascot's entrance is unobstructed.
Author a per-beat performance for seg2 as described in the repair goal — a physical reaction to the 0.65 -> 3.58 climb and the 2018 dip.
Render bar value labels from the start of each race and place them outside/at the bar tip with a contrasting colour.
Give the closing a single unifying line that names why these three measurements sit together, so the payoff has something to land on.

Move the closing card below the chart title (or fade the title out before it appears) so nothing overlaps in seg4.
Keep captions inside the card's safe area with a bottom margin above the source line; cap the caption stack to one line so it cannot run off frame.
Scale bubble AREA to value with a visible size spread (89 clearly ~2x the 40.9 circle), and have Data physically stack or squash them so the ranking is demonstrated rather than labelled.
Either retitle to match the rise to 27.8, or make seg3 demonstrate the flat 1990→2009 stretch (19.3 → 19.7) as the beat the mascot struggles against before the late climb.

Animate the closing balloon in and out (or dock it below the title) so the final 5s isn't a frozen overlay covering the header.
Drop the second source line so only the in-card attribution renders.

Route seg2's bar values through the same formatter as the captions (abbreviate to '2.42B'/'3.46B' or use separators) and measure the label against the bar width so nothing is ever clipped.

Differentiate the three segments — different fill direction, camera framing or a metaphor (stacking figures for rural population, a decelerating racer for urban growth) — and cut seg2 from ~24s to under 12s.

fixes: Bind seg3's two bars to distinct periods and values — left 1980 = 42%, right 2021 = 25% — and fix the subtitle to '1980 VS 2021'; assert the two period tokens differ before render.

Animate seg3 as a physical collapse: start the right bar level with the left, drop it to ~60% height with Data riding the top edge down and landing, then stamp '25%' on it — that turns the stat into a demonstration instead of a static pair.
Move the closing bubble to the lower third (or shrink it) so the chart title stays visible and Data's full body, not just his legs, sits beside it.
Deduplicate the source credit in seg4 to a single line above the safe area.

Open on the 2025 bar snapping into place or Data being launched up the stack, with the '52% — first majority since the Depression' beat front-loaded, instead of a bar chart tinting itself over the first two seconds.
Inset the ranked-bar value labels or place them outside the bar ends in seg2 so 71, 33 and 27 are fully legible rather than clipped digits.

one_line: The animation moves well, but the charts show numbers that are not the story's numbers — seg3 labels both bars '1980 50%' while the voice says 42 percent falling to 25.
problems: seg3:start f13 / seg3:mid f14 / seg4:end f19: two different-height bars both labeled '1980 50%', and the header says '1980 IS 50% OF THE WHOLE' — the 2021 figure of 25 percent never appears on screen.

hook@1.5 f03 and seg1:mid f08: the stacked series reads 1940 22%, 1960 14%, 2012 17%, 2020 24%, 2025 23% — contradicting the narration's 1960 29% and 2020 52%. The subtitle '1940 IS 22% OF THE WHOLE' is a meaningless framing of a time series.
seg4:start f16 and payoff@-1.8 f18: the closing speech bubble is parked directly over the scene title, leaving 'financial independence by 21' struck through and half-legible.
payoff@-0.4 f20: the 'COMMENT BELOW' end card, the four-line source block and the subtitle all overlap in the bottom band, producing an illegible pile of text.
seg2:start f10 / seg2:end f12: the row label is truncated to '3. United States o...' and the bar values (77, 71, 3, 7) render inside/behind the bar ends where they are partly unreadable.
Mascot performance repeats one verb — perch on top of the current bar — across hook, seg0, seg1 and seg3; only seg2's bar-shove is a distinct bit.
fixes: Rebind seg3's series to the real two points (1980 = 42%, 2021 = 25%) and let the second column visibly drop/drain from the first's height; assert at render time that no two bars in a scene share a label or a value.

Rebind the hook/seg0/seg1 stack to the scripted 1960 = 29% and 2020 = 52% figures, and replace the '<year> IS n% OF THE WHOLE' subtitle with a comparison line appropriate to a time series ('1960 -> 2020: 29% -> 52%').
Anchor the closing speech bubble below the title safe-area (or fade the title out before the bubble enters) so nothing overlaps at seg4:start f16.
Reserve the bottom band: end card, subtitle and source credit must occupy separate rows, and shrink the source block to a single line.
Give the ranking rows full width for labels ('3. United States') and place value numbers outside the bar ends.
Vary Data's act per beat — climbing is fine once; give him a distinct action for seg3 (e.g. sinking with the shrinking 2021 column) rather than a fourth perch.

one_line: The closing act shows two identical columns both labelled '1980 50%' while the script says independence collapsed 42% -> 25% — the payoff stat is rendered wrong on screen.
problems: seg3/seg4: both rows labelled '1980  50%'; the 2021 25% figure never appears and the two columns end up the same height, visually contradicting the narrated drop (seg3:end t=35.57s, seg4:end t=41.63s).

seg1: chart values (1940 22%, 1960 14%, 2012 17%, 2020 24%, 2025 23%) don't correspond to the numbers being spoken (29% in 1960, 52% by 2020); the subtitle '1940 IS 22% OF THE WHOLE' reframes the stat as a share of a stack nobody asked about.

seg4 end card: the 'Adulthood got a later start date.' bubble covers the title (only a stray '1' survives at seg4:start t=38.53s) and crops Data to his legs (payoff@-0.4 t=41.87s) — the mascot's payoff beat is hidden behind his own speech bubble.

Bottom of frame is a text pile-up in the last 4s: the source line, the multi-line sources block, the caption and 'COMMENT BELOW' all overlap into illegible mush (payoff@-1.8 t=40.47s, payoff@-0.4 t=41.87s).

Hook is a chart build, not an event: the first thing on screen at hook@0.3 is a bar chart mid-fill with the caption 'Living with' laid across the bars, so nothing surprising happens in the first second.
seg3 wastes the top half of the frame on an empty ghost column while all the action sits in the bottom third (seg3:start t=28.89s).
fixes: Fix the seg3/seg4 series binding: draw 1980 = 42% and 2021 = 25% as two separate, differently-labelled columns of visibly different height, and animate the second one falling short of the first so the drop IS the visual.
Rebind seg1's stack to the narrated series (1960 = 29%, 2020 = 52%) or retitle the scene to what it actually plots; the spoken number and the number under Data's feet must be the same number.
Move the closing speech bubble to the lower third (or shrink it to ~60% width and anchor it beside Data) so the title stays readable and his full body stays in frame during the payoff.
Collapse the end-card credits to one source line and fade the caption out before 'COMMENT BELOW' appears — never stack three text layers in the same 200px band.
Open on the action instead of the axis: start with Data already being shoved upward by a slab slamming in, or a single 52% block crashing down, and let the chart assemble underneath him.
In seg3, scale the column to fill the vertical frame and put Data on top of the falling fill line so the empty upper third becomes the distance he loses.

one_line: Solid, always-moving chart work, but seg4 shows two of its three headline numbers with their leading digits swallowed by the bars while the closing bubble sits on top of the title and the source text sits on top of the CTA.
problems: seg4:mid / payoff@-0.4: South Korea's label renders as '5.6' and Italy's as '0.4' — the bar fill covers the leading digit, so the payoff stat is factually misread.
seg4:start onward: the 'Growing old is optional' bubble occludes the headline ('el...') and kicker ('JAP...'), erasing the chart's own framing at the exact moment the payoff lands.
seg4:end / payoff@-0.4: the grey multi-line source credit prints directly over the blue 'COMMENT BELOW' CTA — both illegible.

seg1 and seg3 both carry the kicker 'JAPAN LEADS THE MAP' even though seg1's headline is 'median age, youngest vs oldest country' — Japan 'leading' a youngest-vs-oldest comparison is a stale, misleading kicker copied across scenes.

seg0–seg1: the source line runs off the right edge of the frame ('...acce') in every sampled frame of that scene.
fixes: In seg4, render bar value labels outside the bar tip (or on an opaque contrast pill) so 80.7 / 75.6 / 60.4 all read in full regardless of fill width.
Anchor the closing speech bubble beneath the title/kicker band, and hide the source credit block whenever the end-card CTA is on screen.
Make the kicker per-scene: seg1 should say something like 'NIGER 15 vs JAPAN 49.9', not 'JAPAN LEADS THE MAP'.
Give the hook an event instead of a build: have Data get visibly lifted/overtaken as the 2024 capsule doubles past the 1974 one in the first second, so frame 1 is a reaction, not a fill.
Wrap or truncate the source line to the safe width so it never bleeds off the right edge.

one_line: The demonstrations are honest and the motion is smooth, but the craft is sloppy — clipped source lines, captions and a speech bubble sitting on top of the titles, and a half-empty bubble scene whose headline number is hidden behind the mascot.

problems: seg2:start wastes roughly the top half of the frame — two small circles low in an otherwise empty card.
seg2:start/seg2:mid: the mascot stands on the 2021 bubble's value label, so 24.2 reads as '2|2' for most of the scene.

Hook (hook@0.3 - hook@1.5): the caption sits directly over the mascot and the 2021 bar, and the hook line is about a 'split-into-4 button' while the visual is a generic bar build — the words and the picture do not meet.

Width-fit or wrap the source string to the card bounds and pin it below the axis labels so it never clips or overlaps (seg2 and seg3).
Raise the payoff speech bubble's anchor below the title band, or fade the title out before the bubble enters, so seg4:start does not clip 'how many loans'.
Move the caption band down out of the chart's first-bar zone in the hook so it stops covering the mascot and the 2021 label.
Open the hook on the split-into-4 button itself — the button snapping into four payment chips — then cut to the bar build, so the first line's promise is what the viewer sees.
Raise the number-ticker baseline so 20 / 14.5 / 16.8 are fully inside the frame, and drop the duplicate source block in seg4/payoff.

one_line: Three competent bar-race charts strung together — but the hook is a slow chart build with the caption printed over the axis labels, Data repeats one pose all 36 seconds, and the 95% scene's labels are cut off the right edge of the frame.
auto_fails: decorative_mascot: Data holds the identical arms-out/dumbbell pose in hook@0.3, seg0:end, seg1:mid, seg3:start and seg4:end — he is only re-parented to whichever bar tip is current; no setup->action->payoff is ever tied to a number.
problems: hook@0.3–hook@2.2: the opener is exactly the banned 'slow chart build' — bars are still growing and nothing else happens; worse, the caption 'Satellites don't' is stamped over the 2000 row so both the label and the line are unreadable.
seg2:start/mid/end: 'Satellite and other  5' and 'Submarine cables  95' are clipped by the right frame edge — the single most important number in the video (95%) is literally cut off.
Mascot: identical arms-out pose in hook@0.3, seg0:end, seg1:mid, seg3:start, seg4:end — he is a sticker that gets re-anchored to the leading bar, never a performer with a bit.
seg1 vs seg3/seg4: two near-identical horizontal bar races with the same layout, same purple/pink palette and same mascot placement — the video visually repeats itself instead of escalating.

seg4:start/mid: the closing card 'The cloud isn't in the sky. It's under the sea.' overlaps and hides the 2010 row while its value is still being revealed, and its tail points at the mascot rather than at anything meaningful.
Cadence: duplicate_ratio 0.293 / effective 17fps against a 24fps sample, with a 27-frame held run at 31.96s — the motion visibly judders rather than reading as smooth.
fixes: Replace the hook with an event, not a build: open on cable snaking across the ocean floor / a satellite dimming out, and move the caption to the lower third so it never sits on the chart's axis labels.
Re-lay out seg2 for 9:16 — labels and percentages inside the column or wrapped to the card margin, verified against the safe area, so '95%' and '5%' are fully visible.

Give Data one real bit per beat: in seg2 have the rising 95% mass lift him and squash him into the 5% sliver; in seg1 have him haul the 2024 bar out to length; in seg4 have him plant the 597th cable. Rotate distinct POSE_PRESETS so no two beats reuse the same act.
Differentiate seg3/seg4 from seg1 — change orientation or metaphor (stacked cable spools, a map filling with routes) so the second half doesn't replay the first.
Move the closing card clear of the 2010 row, or hold it until the final values have landed, so the payoff reveal isn't occluded.
Raise the effective frame rate: render the bar tweens at the export rate rather than duplicating source frames, and break up the 27-frame hold at ~32s.

one_line: Three near-identical bar charts with the mascot perched on the bar tip in the same pose the whole way — competent template, no demonstration and no performance.
auto_fails: decorative_mascot: From hook@0.3 to seg4:end the mascot holds one identical arms-out pose perched on the bar tip, drifting row to row (seg0:mid, seg1:mid, seg3:mid, seg4:mid are the same sticker at different heights) — no setup→action→payoff bit.
problems: hook@0.3–seg0:end: the opener is a slow bar build, and the caption collides with the '2000' row label and bar in hook@0.3, hook@0.8, hook@1.5 and seg0:mid ('run the' is grey text inside a grey bar and is unreadable).
seg0 and seg3 kickers read '2000 PULLS AHEAD' and '2010 PULLS AHEAD' while the visible leaders are 2024 and 2025 — the annotation contradicts the chart.

seg2 (the 95/5 share column): the series labels 'Satellite and other  5' and 'Submarine cables  95' run off the right edge of the frame at seg2:start/mid/end — the two numbers the whole segment exists to deliver are clipped.
The mascot is the same arms-out pose in every single beat (seg0:mid, seg1:mid, seg2:mid, seg3:mid, seg4:mid); he rides the bar tip but never does a bit — no setup, no action, no payoff.

The headline stat is never demonstrated: '1.48 million km — 37 times around the Earth' has no visual metaphor, and bar values (0.9/1.2/1.5) only appear at seg1:end, ~10s in, so the first three beats are unlabelled bars.
payoff@-1.8 onward: the closing card covers the top of the chart and clips the 2010 row, so the final reveal (200/320/530/597 at payoff@-0.4) lands with its first bar hidden.
fixes: Cut a real hook beat: open on the cable line whipping across the ocean floor or the 2024 bar overtaking the field in the first 0.5s, then transition into the race — do not start on a half-built chart.
Move burned captions to a reserved lower-third band that never overlaps the year-label column or bar interiors, and give them a solid backing plate.
Fix the leader kicker to name the actual top bar (2024 / 2025), or drop it.
Pull the seg2 series labels inside the safe area (place them on top of their own segments) so '95%' and '5%' are fully visible.

Give the mascot one distinct act per beat: measuring out cable coils in seg0, being lifted by the rising 95% fill in seg2, hauling in cable #597 in seg3 — different pose, different prop, ending in a payoff gesture on the closing line.
Demonstrate the 1.48M km with a physical metaphor — a cable spooling 37 times around a globe with a counter — instead of a fourth bar row.

one_line: The bar race opens with real energy, but the back half collapses into one big circle, one dot and a lot of empty navy — and clipped/overlapping labels undercut the craft throughout.
auto_fails: empty_void: seg3:start is a near-empty dark card — a small mascot, one tiny pink dot and two labels — and the bottom ~40% of the frame stays dead through seg4:mid and payoff@-0.4.
problems: seg3/seg4 hold a single static composition (95.4 disc + 6.1 dot) for ~14s with only mascot idle motion — the payoff scene is the emptiest one.
seg3:start is a large dead void: tiny mascot, one small dot, nothing else built yet.
seg2 labels collide — 'Full character mixLowercase only' runs together at seg2:start/mid/end, and the source line overlaps them.
seg2's 'lowercase only' side never becomes a column; it stays a squat circle next to a full-height capsule, so the 6887-vs-2 contrast reads as a shape mismatch rather than a scale.
The 6887 and 2 values at seg2:end are low-contrast fill-on-fill and nearly unreadable.
The source footnote in seg3/seg4 is clipped off both frame edges ('ns (character-set definitions)... a').
fixes: Re-stage seg3 as a length demo that fills the card (12 lowercase tiles out-stacking an 8-char mixed block) and keep it animating past the reveal instead of freezing on a disc.
Give Data a real bit in seg3/seg4: he drops the twelfth character and the yellow mass overtakes the mix — setup, action, payoff — rather than standing on the circle.
Stack or right-align the seg2 category labels so 'Full character mix' and 'Lowercase only' cannot butt together, and move the source line clear of them.
Render the seg2 lowercase side in the same column geometry as the mix side so 2 weeks vs 6,887 weeks reads as a height difference, and put both values in high-contrast text above their columns.
Clamp the seg3/seg4 source footnote to the card width (truncate or wrap) so it stops bleeding past both edges.
Open on the bars already snapping into place with a fast entry beat instead of a from-zero build under the title.

one_line: Strong, genuinely motivated data staging with a mascot who actually rides the numbers — undone by amateur label layout that clips the punchline stat off the right edge and ghosts the 6887-vs-2 comparison into near-invisibility.
problems: seg3/seg4: the headline value label is cut off at the frame edge — reads '12-char lowercase  94' with no % — and it stays clipped through payoff@-0.4, so the stat the whole video builds to is never fully shown.
seg1:end: the two key numbers 6887 and 2 are rendered at very low contrast inside their columns (grey-on-yellow, pink-on-pink) and are almost unreadable at scroll speed.
seg1:start–end: the axis captions collide into a single run-on string, 'Full character mixLowercase only', and overlap the source footnote beneath them.
seg3–seg4: the source footnote is clipped at both left and right edges and set far too small to read.
seg4: from payoff@-1.8 to payoff@-0.4 the frame is near-identical — the column has essentially finished and only the mascot drifts a few pixels, so the last ~1.5s coasts.
The mascot's bit is the same 'ride the growing thing, arms up' beat in all four scenes; his pose barely varies between hook@0.8, seg1:mid and seg3:end.
fixes: Constrain the seg3 value labels to the safe area: measure the string, and wrap to two lines or place the label inside the filled block so '12-char lowercase 94%' renders complete with a >=48px right margin.
Raise the seg1 in-column value numbers to full-opacity high-contrast type (dark text on the yellow fill, white on the pink) and size them like the 225/164/132 labels in seg0:end.
Give the seg1 category captions their own row with padding between them so 'Full character mix' and 'Lowercase only' cannot butt together, and move the source line below that row.
Wrap the source footnote to the chart width and bump it to a legible size in seg3/seg4.
Extend the seg4 fill or add a final accent move (bubble pop, column tick-up, mascot gesture) in the last 1.5s so the payoff lands on motion rather than a hold.
Vary Data's pose per beat — e.g. hauling the 2026 bar back in seg0, shoving the lowercase column down in seg1, planting a flag on the 94% block in seg3 — instead of the repeated arms-up ride.

one_line: A competent but generic bar-chart explainer with an inert opening and a mascot who never does anything — the pit stop is never demonstrated, only charted.
auto_fails: junk_imagery: seg0:start/mid/end (t=5.17-11.85s) put a little HOUSE icon in a yellow circle on the 'Current record' row of an F1 pit-stop chart — a topically irrelevant pictogram sitting on the video's headline number.

decorative_mascot: Data only stands with arms at his sides or straight out — perched on the 'Current record' bar at hook@0.3, riding the 1950s bar at seg1:end, parked inside the yellow column at seg2:mid, seg3:start and seg3:mid — never a setup->action->payoff tied to a pit stop (no wheel gun, no jack, no tire swap).
problems: hook@0.3-1.5: two seconds of an empty chart and a title card, no motion beyond word swaps — the classic slow chart build the bar forbids.
Mascot is decoration in every scene: standing arms-out on a bar at hook@0.3, seg1:end, seg2:mid, seg3:start, seg3:mid — no bit, no props, no setup->action->payoff tied to 1.8 seconds or 20 crew.
seg0/seg1: a HOUSE icon in a yellow circle sits on the 'Current record' row (seg1:start, seg1:mid, seg1:end) — irrelevant imagery on the video's key number.
seg2: the two axis labels collide into unreadable text — 'Pit stop recordHuman reaction time' at seg2:start/mid/end.
seg4/payoff: Data is clipped by the callout box and column top — cropped to a torso at seg4:mid, to legs only at payoff@-0.4 — so the closing beat has a headless mascot.
The strongest comparison in the script ('under seven reaction times') is rendered as two plain columns (seg2:mid) rather than seven reaction-time units stacking inside one pit stop.
fixes: Rebuild the hook as an action beat: 1.8s bar snaps full in a blink against a 60s bar still crawling, with Data doing a jack-and-wheel-gun bit; no static title card.

Give Data one real bit per scene from POSE_PRESETS tied to the stat — swapping a tire in seg0, sprinting seven strides across the reaction-time gap in seg2, splitting into a crew line for 20-vs-3 in seg3.
Delete the house icon from the 'Current record' row; use a wheel/stopwatch glyph or leave the bar clean.
Stagger or shrink the seg2 category labels so 'Pit stop record' and 'Human reaction time' no longer overlap.
Reposition the payoff callout (or lower the mascot) so Data is fully in frame at seg4:mid through payoff@-0.4.
Demonstrate seg2 physically: fill the 1.8s bar with seven 0.27s reaction-time blocks clicking in, instead of two smooth columns.

one_line: Every number is a rectangle: the hook is a slow chart build, seg2 and seg3 reuse one identical two-bar template, and Data spends the last 22 seconds standing still on top of a bar.
auto_fails: decorative_mascot: From seg2:start (t=16.8s) through payoff@-0.4 (t=38.43s) Data holds one standing pose parked on top of the yellow bar — he is carried upward by the bar rather than performing any setup->action->payoff tied to 1.8s or 20 crew.

empty_void: hook@0.3-seg0:end leave the bottom ~20% of the frame as a blank navy band, and seg2:start / seg3:start (t=16.8s, 26.17s) leave the top ~55% as two empty ghost tracks with only a tiny 'vs' in the gap.
problems: hook@0.3-hook@2.2: the opener is exactly the thing the rubric forbids — a title card ('F1 pit stop time') over a slow bar build, with the hook line pasted across it and the bottom fifth of the frame left as a blank navy band.
seg2:start and seg3:start are the same composition with different labels; the crew beat demonstrates nothing the reaction-time beat did not already show.
seg2/seg3 hold the top ~55% of the frame as empty ghost tracks for ~8s per beat while the value stays hidden until the very end of the beat.
The mascot is inert from t=16.8s onward — one standing pose riding the yellow column, no bit tied to 1.8 seconds or to twenty crew members.
seg1:end: the '60', '.9' and '.8' value labels are clipped by the row-label gutter and occluded by the mascot, so the central comparison (60s vs 1.8s) is never cleanly readable.

Layout collisions throughout: 'Current record' overlaps its bar (hook@0.3), 'Pit stop record'/'Human reaction time' overlap each other (seg2:end), and the stacked source lines collide with 'COMMENT BELOW' (payoff@-0.4).
fixes: Open on action, not a chart: cold-open on a wheel gun hitting a nut and the car dropping in 1.8s with a hard timer slam, then reveal the comparison — no title card, no bar build in the first 2s.

Re-stage seg3 as 20 discrete crew figures swarming a car versus 3 in the 1950s, with Data doing one named job in the swarm; give it a different camera and layout from seg2 so the two beats cannot be confused.

Make the values appear as the bars grow (counter riding the bar tip), not at the end of the beat, and pull the value label out of the row-label gutter so '60', '1.8', '0.27', '20' and '3' are always legible.

Fill the empty upper columns in seg2/seg3 — scale the tracks to the frame or stack repeated units (seven reaction-time blocks inside the 1.8s bar) so the space carries information instead of ghost outlines.
Give Data a per-beat bit: jack the car in seg1, blink-and-miss on the reaction-time beat, wheel-gun in the crew beat — setup, action, payoff, with his position changing each time.
Fix the label layout: keep 'Current record'/'Modern crew'/'1950s crew' clear of the bars, and collapse the stacked source lines into one line above the CTA.

one_line: A genuine race with a real lead change — Nvidia crossing Apple at 2024-25 lands — held back only by a hook caption that sits on top of the line it is describing.
problems: hook@0.3–1.5: the caption card overlaps the Apple line tip and its value label, and dims to low-contrast brown before it clears.
hook@0.3 through mid1: the axis rescales three times (1600B → 2000B → 2500B → 3500B) inside the first 4.5s, so the early growth reads as jitter rather than climb.
Bottom source line is truncated mid-word ('for Apple and Nv...') in every frame.
The overtake itself passes without emphasis — between mid4 (t=10.40s, Apple still ahead) and mid5 (t=12.38s, leaderboard already flipped) there is no beat marking the crossing.
~1.1s duplicate run at t=13.29s leaves a slightly frozen tail on the final card.
fixes: Anchor the hook caption to a plot region with no line in it and give it a solid backing; keep it fully opaque for its whole life instead of fading through a low-contrast brown.
Pre-compute the final y-max (or ease the rescale once) so the first 4s reads as growth, not repeated axis resets.
Shorten or wrap the source credit so it is not cut mid-word.
Add a one-beat crossover emphasis at the moment Nvidia passes Apple (~t=11s): flash the crossing point and swap the leaderboard rows with a visible transition.
Extend the final #1 Nvidia card with a small continuing motion (value tick-up or line glow) to kill the ~1s frozen tail.

one_line: A legitimately good graph race — real crossover, reordering leaderboard, clean year counter — undercut by a hook banner pasted over its own data and a chart that wastes the bottom half of the frame.
problems: hook@0.3–1.5: the 'Cable's reign just ended' banner sits on top of the plot, occluding the Cable TV line tip and its logo; at hook@1.5 it is a half-faded illegible overlay across the chart.
hook@0.3/0.8: the Cable TV logo cutout is doubled/smeared at the line tip, reading as a rendering artifact rather than a marker.
All frames: y-axis runs 0–50 while both series live in 19–45, so the bottom ~40% of the plot (mid3, mid4) is permanent empty black doing no work.
hook@0.3: the race opens on an almost-empty axis with two dots at the left edge — a slow chart build, the exact hook shape the rubric calls out.
payoff@-0.4: the ending adds only a small '#1 Streaming' line; the crossover — the actual story — gets no emphasis when it happens at mid2.
mid0 (t=2.50s) is visually near-identical to hook@2.2 (same 2020, Cable 38 / Streaming 23), so the transition into the body reads as a stall.
fixes: Relocate the hook banner out of the plot area (under the year counter or above the leaderboard) with a hard collision margin against the line tips, and cut it fully rather than cross-fading it over the chart.
Tighten the y-axis to the data range (e.g. 15–50) so the lines fill the frame instead of floating in the top half.
Open on motion: pre-roll the race at high speed for ~0.5s, or cold-open on the 2022 crossover and rewind, so frame one is not a bare axis.
Punch the crossover at mid2 — hold beat, flash/thicken both lines, and pop a 'streaming passes cable' callout at the intersection point.
Draw the logo marker once per series per frame to kill the doubled-cutout smear at hook@0.3/0.8.
Land the payoff harder: after '#1 Streaming', animate the 45 vs 24 gap (bar, delta arrow, or shading between the curves) so the ending is a whoa, not a caption.

one_line: A genuinely satisfying race with a real overtake and a clean landing, undercut by a hook whose caption sits on top of the leader's label over a nearly empty chart.

hook@1.5: caption fades out as flat grey text across the plot area, reading as a rendering artifact rather than a designed transition.
hook@0.3–hook@2.2: the plot is ~85% empty black with two short stubs — the first two seconds have little to look at beyond the title.
payoff@-1.8 to payoff@-0.4: the final ~1.4s is nearly frozen (27.2B → 28B, max_dup_run 34 at 12.96s); the '#1 TikTok' stamp is the only new element and it arrives late.
Global: effective 19.3fps against a 24fps sample with 0.195 duplicate ratio — the line growth reads slightly steppy rather than smooth.
fixes: Reposition or auto-dodge the hook caption so it never overlaps a series tip label — the lower-right quadrant is empty for the entire first half.
Cut the caption with a fast wipe/scale-out instead of an alpha fade so it never renders as ghosted grey text over the grid.
Start the race with the axis pre-scaled and the 2019–2020 segment sweeping in over ~0.5s so hook@0.3 already has motion and shape.
Bring the '#1 TikTok' stamp in ~1s earlier and give the final hold a live element (tip pulse, counter tick to 28B) so the last 1.4s isn't a frozen frame.
Raise the interpolation step count between years so unique-frame rate approaches the export rate and the line growth stops juddering.

problems: Hook is a slow bar-chart build under a plain title card ('F1 pit stop time' + '1950S PULLS AHEAD', f00–f06) with the bars still empty at t=2.2s — no motion event and no reason to stay.
